safety_limits: sanitized metadata and synthetic fixtures only
no GitHub mutation, runtime connection, SQL execution, backup, restore, deployment, or production operation
candidate/static evidence does not establish reachability, runtime behavior, authorization, recovery success, RPO, or RTO
all product/runtime/CI results remain NOT_RUN until an eligible fenced lease and required environments exist
title: Non-destructive coexistence, kill-switch and rollback fixtures

eligibility.decision: preparation_only; READY label does not grant code or operation

may: route to previous known-good compatible Web build
move config pointer to previous validated compatible immutable version
preserve and reconcile in-flight command state
fence queued workers by release/config/scope generation and require fresh authorization before dispatch
must_not: restore production database as routine application rollback

cases.synthetic_trigger: slice kill switch is activated with in-flight reads and commands
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: stop new entry, preserve/reconcile accepted work, expose stable state
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: per-slice admission fence and in-flight state inventory

cases.synthetic_trigger: previous Web build expects a different API/schema/config contract
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: build/API/schema/config compatibility manifest and smoke test

cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: fail CAS and preserve current pointer
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: expected-version rollback test and audit record

cases.synthetic_trigger: recent business transaction committed before build rollback
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: preserve transaction and re-read authoritative state
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: command audit/reconciliation and coexistence read test

cases.synthetic_trigger: command outcome is unknown during cutover
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: handoff reconciliation identity; never replay blindly
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: B5 outcome state and runbook ownership proof

cases.synthetic_trigger: legacy client retains Forever1Day configuration cache
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: show coexistence lag and use approved refresh/restart procedure
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: verified cache consumer behavior and dirty-session-safe runbook

cases.synthetic_trigger: WinForms writes while Web slice is disabled
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: surface through authorized revalidation after re-enable

cases.synthetic_trigger: migration proposes dropping/renaming shared legacy schema on rollback
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: additive schema review and both-client compatibility test

cases.synthetic_trigger: old session/event response arrives after build or config switch
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: fence by generation/version and authoritative reread

cases.synthetic_trigger: kill switch hides UI but API remains callable
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: five-layer capability test for disabled slice

cases.synthetic_trigger: team treats database restore as ordinary release rollback
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: separate disaster recovery under R4 approval
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: reviewed rollback versus recovery decision record

cases.synthetic_trigger: release sign-off relies on termination without checking state
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: exact build/config heads, current checks, data reconciliation and owner sign-off

cases.synthetic_trigger: queued report/command from old release waits across kill-switch or rollback
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: do not dispatch under new release implicitly; fence, reauthorize and apply exact operation policy
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: durable queue inventory with release/config/scope generation and drain/cancel/reconcile test

cases.synthetic_trigger: old Web build remains live and writes after slice disable generation
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: server admission fence rejects stale generation before harmful operation

cases.synthetic_trigger: new build starts reading before config/schema compatibility pointer is committed
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: readiness stays false and traffic remains on compatible generation

cases.synthetic_trigger: rollback completes while report artifacts/events from superseded generation remain visible
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: visibility/download/event consumers reauthorize and reconcile by generation; no stale success claim
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: artifact/event generation fencing and post-rollback reconciliation test
